_comment: Gain / operating-point / threshold profile for verify_cosim_pid.py. RAW gains include the sign (BOTH integer and float P are POSITIVE on the current 23 uA sinusoid-blend plant). MODEL+BUILD specific (GroupTb WAFER, VARIATION_SEED=0). Revalidated closed-loop 2026-09-17 on the merged multi-flux-wrap RTL: integer locks with normalized P=+0.05, I=+0.0004 at SampleCount=20 (raw P=+0.0025, I=+2e-5); the old negative-P values from the 10 uA fixture did NOT lock (feedback railed). These are NOT physical SQUID acceptance. Copy and adjust per fixture. Any block/key is optional; omitted values fall back to the built-in DEFAULTS in verify_cosim_pid.py, and --cli flags override this file.
